title: Who wrote the rules?
description:
I don't know who needs to hear this…
You're not behind in life. You're not doing anything wrong. You're exactly where you need to be 🌟

We spend so much time looking at other people's lives, comparing their highs with our lows, and asking why not us? 💭

We beat ourselves up for doing too little, taking too long, falling behind. But according to who?

There's NO script. There's NO timeline. There are NO rules.
Write your own story and enjoy the journey 🫶

#lifeinyour20s #nyclife #selfgrowth #mindset
